notes: Both articles of הַגֶּפֶן הַזֹּאת are unrepresented, since the demonstrative morpheme itself takes the written 'this' — rule 41's limit, as in rule 18's הִיא נִתְּנָה הָאָרֶץ.
The purpose clause is moved to the end of the verse; 'that' stays on the lamed and the subject and modal on the infinitive (rule 52), the units discontinuous under rule 25.
